# Public API snapshot

Regenerate with: go test ./internal/apisnapshot -run TestPublicAPISnapshot -update

T-27: every exported declaration (types with full field lists and tags,
func/method signatures, consts with values, vars) across every publicly
importable package this module ships — github.com/brennoo/go-gmp and its
client, commands, commands/filtering, commands/pagination and connections
subpackages. Any diff here is a reviewed API decision, never a mechanical
fix-the-build step.

Deliberately excluded: internal/... and examples/... (not importable by
consumers), all _test.go files, and doc comments (churn without API meaning
— struct tags are kept, since xml/gmpwire/gmpoverride tags are wire-behavior
API here, not documentation).

client's section is one line by design: client.New returns the gmp.Client
interface, and every method on its unexported *client implementation is only
reachable through that interface, whose signature this snapshot already
captures in the root package's Client section. A method added to *client
without a matching Client entry is a compile error, not something this
golden needs to also catch.

total packages: 6
total exported declarations: 1817

type Connection interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, command interface{}, response interface{}) error
	Close() error
	RawXML(ctx context.Context, xml string) (string, error)
}

## github.com/brennoo/go-gmp/client

func New(conn gmp.Connection) gmp.Client

## github.com/brennoo/go-gmp/commands

type Agent struct {
	ID                string            `xml:"id,attr"`
	Owner             *AgentOwner       `xml:"owner,omitempty"`
	Name              string            `xml:"name"`
	Comment           string            `xml:"comment,omitempty"`
	CreationTime      *GMPTime          `xml:"creation_time,omitempty"`
	ModificationTime  *GMPTime          `xml:"modification_time,omitempty"`
	Writable          bool              `xml:"writable,omitempty"`
	InUse             bool              `xml:"in_use,omitempty"`
	Permissions       *AgentPermissions `xml:"permissions,omitempty"`
	Hostname          string            `xml:"hostname,omitempty"`
	AgentID           string            `xml:"agent_id,omitempty"`
	Authorized        int               `xml:"authorized,omitempty"`
	MinInterval       int               `xml:"min_interval,omitempty"`
	HeartbeatInterval int               `xml:"heartbeat_interval,omitempty"`
	ConnectionStatus  string            `xml:"connection_status,omitempty"`
	LastUpdate        *GMPTime          `xml:"last_update,omitempty"`
	Schedule          string            `xml:"schedule,omitempty"`
	Scanner           *AgentScanner     `xml:"scanner,omitempty"`
	IP                []string          `xml:"ip,omitempty"`
}

type AgentOwner struct {
	Name string `xml:"name"`
}

type AgentPermission struct {
	Name string `xml:"name"`
}

type AgentPermissions struct {
	Permission []AgentPermission `xml:"permission"`
}

type AgentScanner struct {
	ID   string `xml:"id,attr"`
	Name string `xml:"name"`
}

type Aggregate struct {
	DataType       string              `xml:"data_type"`
	ColumnInfo     AggregateColumnInfo `xml:"column_info"`
	GroupColumn    string              `xml:"group_column,omitempty"`
	SubgroupColumn string              `xml:"subgroup_column,omitempty"`
	Subgroups      *AggregateSubgroups `xml:"subgroups,omitempty"`
	DataColumn     []string            `xml:"data_column,omitempty"`
	TextColumn     []string            `xml:"text_column,omitempty"`
	Overall        *AggregateOverall   `xml:"overall,omitempty"`
	Group          []AggregateGroup    `xml:"group,omitempty"`
}

type AggregateColumn struct {
	Name     string `xml:"name"`
	Stat     string `xml:"stat"`
	Type     string `xml:"type"`
	Column   string `xml:"column"`
	DataType string `xml:"data_type"`
}

type AggregateColumnInfo struct {
	AggregateColumn []AggregateColumn `xml:"aggregate_column,omitempty"`
}

type AggregateFilters struct {
	ID       string            `xml:"id,attr"`
	Term     string            `xml:"term"`
	Keywords AggregateKeywords `xml:"keywords"`
	Name     string            `xml:"name,omitempty"`
}

type AggregateGroup struct {
	Value    string              `xml:"value"`
	Count    int                 `xml:"count"`
	CCount   int                 `xml:"c_count"`
	Subgroup []AggregateSubgroup `xml:"subgroup,omitempty"`
	Stats    []AggregateStats    `xml:"stats,omitempty"`
	Text     []AggregateText     `xml:"text,omitempty"`
	Min      string              `xml:"min,omitempty" gmpoverride:"T-9 aggregate review: command_get_aggregates.xml's <group> pattern declares only value/subgroup/count/c_count/stats/text — per-column stats wrapped in <stats column=\"...\"> — but the command's own <example> and internal/gmptest/testdata/upstream/get_aggregates/001_response.xml both show a flat <min> directly under <group> for the single-data_column case, the same pattern-vs-example disagreement as verify_scanner's version"`
	Max      string              `xml:"max,omitempty" gmpoverride:"T-9 aggregate review: see the min entry above; same flat <max> shape confirmed by the same evidence"`
	Mean     string              `xml:"mean,omitempty" gmpoverride:"T-9 aggregate review: see the min entry above; same flat <mean> shape confirmed by the same evidence"`
	Sum      string              `xml:"sum,omitempty" gmpoverride:"T-9 aggregate review: see the min entry above; same flat <sum> shape confirmed by the same evidence"`
	CSum     string              `xml:"c_sum,omitempty" gmpoverride:"T-9 aggregate review: see the min entry above; same flat <c_sum> shape confirmed by the same evidence"`
}

type AggregateKeyword struct {
	Column   string            `xml:"column"`
	Relation AggregateRelation `xml:"relation"`
	Value    string            `xml:"value"`
}

type AggregateKeywords struct {
	Keyword []AggregateKeyword `xml:"keyword,omitempty"`
}

type AggregateOverall struct {
	Count  int              `xml:"count"`
	CCount int              `xml:"c_count"`
	Stats  []AggregateStats `xml:"stats,omitempty"`
	Text   []AggregateText  `xml:"text,omitempty"`
}

type AggregateRelation string

const (
	AggregateRelationEq       AggregateRelation = "="
	AggregateRelationContains AggregateRelation = ":"
	AggregateRelationRegex    AggregateRelation = "~"
	AggregateRelationGT       AggregateRelation = ">"
	AggregateRelationLT       AggregateRelation = "<"
)

type AggregateSort struct {
	Field string `xml:"field,attr,omitempty"`
	Order string `xml:"order,attr,omitempty"`
	Stat  string `xml:"stat,attr,omitempty"`
}

type AggregateStats struct {
	Column string `xml:"column,attr,omitempty"`
	Min    string `xml:"min"`
	Max    string `xml:"max"`
	Mean   string `xml:"mean"`
	Sum    string `xml:"sum"`
	CSum   string `xml:"c_sum"`
}

type AggregateSubgroup struct {
	Value  string           `xml:"value"`
	Count  int              `xml:"count"`
	CCount int              `xml:"c_count"`
	Stats  []AggregateStats `xml:"stats,omitempty"`
}

type AggregateSubgroups struct {
	Value []string `xml:"value,omitempty"`
}

type AggregateText struct {
	Value  string `xml:",chardata"`
	Name   string `xml:"name,attr,omitempty"`
	Column string `xml:"column,attr,omitempty" gmpoverride:"T-9 aggregate review: command_get_aggregates.xml's schema declares <text>'s lone attribute as \"name\", but internal/gmptest/testdata/live/get_aggregates/004_response.xml sends a real gvmd 26.36.1 <text column=\"name\"> — a second, undeclared attribute the schema never mentions at all, kept alongside the schema-declared (and seemingly unused) Name field since there is no evidence the schema's own declaration is categorically wrong rather than an alternate/legacy form. AggregateText is one structurally-deduplicated type shared by both aggregate/group/text and aggregate/overall/text, so both must carry this same entry"`
}

type Alert struct {
	ID               string           `xml:"id,attr"`
	Owner            AlertOwner       `xml:"owner"`
	Name             string           `xml:"name"`
	Comment          string           `xml:"comment"`
	CreationTime     GMPTime          `xml:"creation_time"`
	ModificationTime GMPTime          `xml:"modification_time"`
	InUse            GMPBool          `xml:"in_use"`
	Writable         GMPBool          `xml:"writable"`
	Permissions      AlertPermissions `xml:"permissions"`
	Condition        AlertCondition   `xml:"condition"`
	Event            AlertEvent       `xml:"event"`
	Method           GetAlertsMethod  `xml:"method"`
	Filter           GetAlertsFilter  `xml:"filter"`
	Active           GMPBool          `xml:"active"`
	UserTags         *AlertUserTags   `xml:"user_tags,omitempty"`
	Tasks            *AlertTasks      `xml:"tasks,omitempty"`
}

type AlertCertificateInfo struct {
	TimeStatus        AlertTimeStatus `xml:"time_status"`
	ActivationTime    string          `xml:"activation_time"`
	ExpirationTime    string          `xml:"expiration_time"`
	Issuer            string          `xml:"issuer"`
	MD5Fingerprint    string          `xml:"md5_fingerprint"`
	SHA256Fingerprint string          `xml:"sha256_fingerprint,omitempty"`
	Subject           string          `xml:"subject,omitempty"`
	Serial            string          `xml:"serial,omitempty"`
}

type AlertCondition struct {
	Value string      `xml:",chardata"`
	Data  []AlertData `xml:"data,omitempty"`
}

type AlertCount struct {
	Value    int `xml:",chardata" gmpoverride:"T-23: count-wrapper chardata total is schema-undeclared"`
	Filtered int `xml:"filtered"`
	Page     int `xml:"page"`
}

type AlertOrder string

const (
	AlertOrderAscending  AlertOrder = "ascending"
	AlertOrderDescending AlertOrder = "descending"
)

	AlertRelationEq       AlertRelation = "="

type AlertTimeStatus string

const (
	AlertTimeStatusExpired  AlertTimeStatus = "expired"
	AlertTimeStatusInactive AlertTimeStatus = "inactive"
	AlertTimeStatusUnknown  AlertTimeStatus = "unknown"
	AlertTimeStatusValid    AlertTimeStatus = "valid"
)

type AlertUserTags struct {

type AssetFilters struct {

type Config struct {
	ID               string              `xml:"id,attr"`
	Owner            ConfigOwner         `xml:"owner"`
	Name             string              `xml:"name"`
	Comment          string              `xml:"comment"`
	CreationTime     GMPTime             `xml:"creation_time"`
	ModificationTime GMPTime             `xml:"modification_time"`
	FamilyCount      ConfigFamilyCount   `xml:"family_count"`

	UsageType        ConfigUsageType     `xml:"usage_type"`
	MaxNVTCount      int                 `xml:"max_nvt_count"`
	KnownNVTCount    int                 `xml:"known_nvt_count"`
	InUse            GMPBool             `xml:"in_use"`
	Writable         GMPBool             `xml:"writable"`
	Permissions      ConfigPermissions   `xml:"permissions"`
	Tasks            ConfigTasks         `xml:"tasks"`
	Predefined       GMPBool             `xml:"predefined"`
	Scanner          *ConfigScanner      `xml:"scanner,omitempty"`
	UserTags         *ConfigUserTags     `xml:"user_tags,omitempty"`
	Families         *ConfigFamilies     `xml:"families,omitempty"`
	Preferences      *ConfigPreferences  `xml:"preferences,omitempty"`
	NVTSelectors     *ConfigNVTSelectors `xml:"nvt_selectors,omitempty"`
	Deprecated       *GMPBool            `xml:"deprecated,omitempty"`
}

type Credential struct {
	ID               string                     `xml:"id,attr"`
	Owner            CredentialOwner            `xml:"owner"`
	Name             string                     `xml:"name"`
	AllowInsecure    GMPBool                    `xml:"allow_insecure"`
	Login            string                     `xml:"login"`
	Comment          string                     `xml:"comment"`
	CreationTime     GMPTime                    `xml:"creation_time"`
	ModificationTime GMPTime                    `xml:"modification_time"`
	Writable         GMPBool                    `xml:"writable"`
	InUse            GMPBool                    `xml:"in_use"`
	Permissions      CredentialPermissions      `xml:"permissions"`
	Type             CredentialType             `xml:"type"`
	FullType         string                     `xml:"full_type"`
	Formats          CredentialFormats          `xml:"formats"`
	UserTags         *CredentialUserTags        `xml:"user_tags,omitempty"`
	AuthAlgorithm    CredentialAuthAlgorithm    `xml:"auth_algorithm,omitempty"`
	Privacy          *GetCredentialsPrivacy     `xml:"privacy,omitempty"`
	CertificateInfo  *CredentialCertificateInfo `xml:"certificate_info,omitempty"`
	PrivateKeyInfo   *CredentialPrivateKeyInfo  `xml:"private_key_info,omitempty"`
	PublicKeyInfo    *CredentialPublicKeyInfo   `xml:"public_key_info,omitempty"`
	Scanners         *CredentialScanners        `xml:"scanners,omitempty"`
	Targets          *CredentialTargets         `xml:"targets,omitempty"`
	PublicKey        string                     `xml:"public_key,omitempty"`
	Package          *CredentialPackage         `xml:"package,omitempty"`
	Certificate      string                     `xml:"certificate,omitempty"`
	Kdc              string                     `xml:"kdc,omitempty"`
	Kdcs             *CredentialKdcs            `xml:"kdcs,omitempty"`
	Realm            string                     `xml:"realm,omitempty"`
}

type CredentialAlgorithm string

const (
	CredentialAlgorithmAes CredentialAlgorithm = "aes"
	CredentialAlgorithmDes CredentialAlgorithm = "des"
)

type CredentialAuthAlgorithm string

const (
	CredentialAuthAlgorithmMD5  CredentialAuthAlgorithm = "md5"
	CredentialAuthAlgorithmSha1 CredentialAuthAlgorithm = "sha1"
)

type CredentialCertificateInfo struct {
	TimeStatus        CredentialTimeStatus `xml:"time_status"`
	ActivationTime    string               `xml:"activation_time"`
	ExpirationTime    string               `xml:"expiration_time"`
	Issuer            string               `xml:"issuer"`
	MD5Fingerprint    string               `xml:"md5_fingerprint"`
	SHA256Fingerprint string               `xml:"sha256_fingerprint,omitempty"`
	Subject           string               `xml:"subject,omitempty"`
	Serial            string               `xml:"serial,omitempty"`
}

type CredentialCount struct {
	Value    int `xml:",chardata" gmpoverride:"T-23: count-wrapper chardata total is schema-undeclared"`
	Filtered int `xml:"filtered"`
	Page     int `xml:"page"`
}

type CredentialField struct {
	Value string          `xml:",chardata" gmpoverride:"T-18a: sort-field chardata is nested under <field>"`
	Order CredentialOrder `xml:"order"`
}

type CredentialFilters struct {
	ID       string             `xml:"id,attr"`
	Term     string             `xml:"term"`
	Keywords CredentialKeywords `xml:"keywords"`
	Name     string             `xml:"name,omitempty"`
}

type CredentialFormat string

const (
	CredentialFormatKey CredentialFormat = "key"
	CredentialFormatRpm CredentialFormat = "rpm"
	CredentialFormatDeb CredentialFormat = "deb"
	CredentialFormatExe CredentialFormat = "exe"
	CredentialFormatPem CredentialFormat = "pem"
)

	Format []CredentialFormat `xml:"format,omitempty"`
}

	Kdc []string `xml:"kdc,omitempty"`
}

	Phrase  string `xml:"phrase,omitempty"`

	Public  string `xml:"public,omitempty"`

}

	Keyword []CredentialKeyword `xml:"keyword,omitempty"`
}

const (
	CredentialOrderAscending  CredentialOrder = "ascending"
	CredentialOrderDescending CredentialOrder = "descending"
)

type CredentialOwner struct {
	Name string `xml:"name"`
}

type CredentialPackage struct {
	Value  string `xml:",chardata"`
	Format string `xml:"format,attr"`
}

type CredentialPermission struct {
	Name string `xml:"name"`
}

	Permission []CredentialPermission `xml:"permission,omitempty"`
}

type CredentialPrivacy struct {
	Algorithm CredentialAlgorithm `xml:"algorithm"`
	Password  string              `xml:"password"`
}

type CredentialPrivateKeyInfo struct {
	Type       string `xml:"type,omitempty"`
	SHA256Hash string `xml:"sha256_hash,omitempty"`
}

type CredentialPublicKeyInfo struct {
	Fingerprint string `xml:"fingerprint,omitempty"`
}

type CredentialRelation string

const (
	CredentialRelationEq       CredentialRelation = "="
	CredentialRelationContains CredentialRelation = ":"
	CredentialRelationRegex    CredentialRelation = "~"
	CredentialRelationGT       CredentialRelation = ">"
	CredentialRelationLT       CredentialRelation = "<"
)

	ID          string `xml:"id,attr"`

	Field CredentialField `xml:"field"`
}

	Value   string `xml:"value"`
	Comment string `xml:"comment"`
}

	ID          string `xml:"id,attr"`

}

}

const (
	CredentialTimeStatusExpired  CredentialTimeStatus = "expired"
	CredentialTimeStatusInactive CredentialTimeStatus = "inactive"
	CredentialTimeStatusUnknown  CredentialTimeStatus = "unknown"
	CredentialTimeStatusValid    CredentialTimeStatus = "valid"
)

const (
	CredentialTypeCc    CredentialType = "cc"
	CredentialTypeKrb5  CredentialType = "krb5"

	ErrorTypeUnknown ErrorType = iota
	ErrorTypeAuthentication
	ErrorTypeNotFound
	ErrorTypePermission
	ErrorTypeInvalidRequest
	ErrorTypeServerError
)

}

	Type             string                `xml:"type"`
	Name             string                `xml:"name"`
	Version          string                `xml:"version"`
	Description      string                `xml:"description"`

}

	Error string `xml:"error"`
}

type Filter struct {
	ID               string            `xml:"id,attr"`
	Owner            FilterOwner       `xml:"owner"`
	Name             string            `xml:"name"`
	Comment          string            `xml:"comment"`
	Term             string            `xml:"term"`
	Type             string            `xml:"type"`
	CreationTime     GMPTime           `xml:"creation_time"`
	ModificationTime GMPTime           `xml:"modification_time"`
	InUse            GMPBool           `xml:"in_use"`
	Writable         GMPBool           `xml:"writable"`
	Permissions      FilterPermissions `xml:"permissions"`
	UserTags         *FilterUserTags   `xml:"user_tags,omitempty"`
	Alerts           *FilterAlerts     `xml:"alerts,omitempty"`
}

type FilterAlert struct {
	ID          string `xml:"id,attr"`
	Name        string `xml:"name"`
	Permissions string `xml:"permissions,omitempty"`
}

	Alert []FilterAlert `xml:"alert,omitempty"`
}

type FilterCount struct {
	Value    int `xml:",chardata" gmpoverride:"T-23: count-wrapper chardata total is schema-undeclared"`
	Filtered int `xml:"filtered"`
	Page     int `xml:"page"`
}

type FilterField struct {
	Value string      `xml:",chardata" gmpoverride:"T-18a: sort-field chardata is nested under <field>"`
	Order FilterOrder `xml:"order"`
}

type FilterKeyword struct {
	Column   string         `xml:"column"`
	Relation FilterRelation `xml:"relation"`
	Value    string         `xml:"value"`
}

type FilterKeywords struct {
	Keyword []FilterKeyword `xml:"keyword,omitempty"`
}

type FilterOrder string

const (
	FilterOrderAscending  FilterOrder = "ascending"
	FilterOrderDescending FilterOrder = "descending"
)

type FilterOwner struct {
	Name string `xml:"name"`
}

type FilterPermission struct {
	Name string `xml:"name"`
}

type FilterPermissions struct {
	Permission []FilterPermission `xml:"permission,omitempty"`
}

type FilterRelation string

const (
	FilterRelationEq       FilterRelation = "="
	FilterRelationContains FilterRelation = ":"
	FilterRelationRegex    FilterRelation = "~"
	FilterRelationGT       FilterRelation = ">"
	FilterRelationLT       FilterRelation = "<"
)

type FilterSort struct {
	Field FilterField `xml:"field"`
}

type FilterTag struct {
	ID      string `xml:"id,attr"`
	Name    string `xml:"name"`
	Value   string `xml:"value"`
	Comment string `xml:"comment"`
}

	Count int         `xml:"count"`
	Tag   []FilterTag `xml:"tag,omitempty"`
}

}

type GMPAtoiBool bool

func (b GMPAtoiBool) MarshalXML(e *xml.Encoder, start xml.StartElement) error

func (b GMPAtoiBool) MarshalXMLAttr(name xml.Name) (xml.Attr, error)

func (b *GMPAtoiBool) UnmarshalXML(d *xml.Decoder, start xml.StartElement) error

func (b *GMPAtoiBool) UnmarshalXMLAttr(attr xml.Attr) error

type GMPBool bool

func (b GMPBool) MarshalXML(e *xml.Encoder, start xml.StartElement) error

func (b GMPBool) MarshalXMLAttr(name xml.Name) (xml.Attr, error)

func (b *GMPBool) UnmarshalXML(d *xml.Decoder, start xml.StartElement) error

func (b *GMPBool) UnmarshalXMLAttr(attr xml.Attr) error

type Group struct {
	ID               string           `xml:"id,attr"`
	Owner            GroupOwner       `xml:"owner"`
	Name             string           `xml:"name"`
	Comment          string           `xml:"comment"`
	CreationTime     GMPTime          `xml:"creation_time"`
	ModificationTime GMPTime          `xml:"modification_time"`
	Writable         GMPBool          `xml:"writable"`
	InUse            GMPBool          `xml:"in_use"`
	Permissions      GroupPermissions `xml:"permissions"`
	Users            string           `xml:"users"`
	UserTags         *GroupUserTags   `xml:"user_tags,omitempty"`
}

type GroupCount struct {
	Value    int `xml:",chardata" gmpoverride:"T-23: count-wrapper chardata total is schema-undeclared"`
	Filtered int `xml:"filtered"`
	Page     int `xml:"page"`
}

type GroupField struct {
	Value string     `xml:",chardata" gmpoverride:"T-18a: sort-field chardata is nested under <field>"`
	Order GroupOrder `xml:"order"`
}

type GroupFilters struct {
	ID       string        `xml:"id,attr"`
	Term     string        `xml:"term"`
	Keywords GroupKeywords `xml:"keywords"`
	Name     string        `xml:"name,omitempty"`
}

type GroupKeyword struct {
	Column   string        `xml:"column"`
	Relation GroupRelation `xml:"relation"`
	Value    string        `xml:"value"`
}

type GroupKeywords struct {
	Keyword []GroupKeyword `xml:"keyword,omitempty"`
}

type GroupOrder string

const (
	GroupOrderAscending  GroupOrder = "ascending"
	GroupOrderDescending GroupOrder = "descending"
)

type GroupOwner struct {
	Name string `xml:"name"`
}

type GroupPermission struct {
	Name string `xml:"name"`
}

type GroupPermissions struct {
	Permission []GroupPermission `xml:"permission,omitempty"`
}

type GroupRelation string

const (
	GroupRelationEq       GroupRelation = "="
	GroupRelationContains GroupRelation = ":"
	GroupRelationRegex    GroupRelation = "~"
	GroupRelationGT       GroupRelation = ">"
	GroupRelationLT       GroupRelation = "<"
)

type GroupSort struct {
	Field GroupField `xml:"field"`
}

type GroupSpecials struct {
	Full string `xml:"full"`
}

type GroupTag struct {
	ID      string `xml:"id,attr"`
	Name    string `xml:"name"`
	Value   string `xml:"value"`
	Comment string `xml:"comment"`
}

type GroupUserTags struct {
	Count int        `xml:"count"`
	Tag   []GroupTag `xml:"tag,omitempty"`
}

type Groups struct {
	Start int `xml:"start,attr"`
	Max   int `xml:"max,attr"`
}

type Help struct {
	XMLName xml.Name `xml:"help"`
	Format  string   `xml:"format,attr,omitempty"`
	Type    string   `xml:"type,attr,omitempty"`
}

	Meta       LicenseMeta       `xml:"meta"`

}

	Value string `xml:",chardata"`
	Name  string `xml:"name,attr,omitempty"`
}

type LicenseKeys struct {
	Key []LicenseKey `xml:"key,omitempty"`
}

type LicenseMeta struct {
	Version      string  `xml:"version"`
	ID           string  `xml:"id"`
	Comment      string  `xml:"comment"`
	Type         string  `xml:"type"`
	CustomerName string  `xml:"customer_name"`
	Created      GMPTime `xml:"created"`
	Begins       GMPTime `xml:"begins"`
	Expires      GMPTime `xml:"expires"`
}

}

type ModifyAgents struct {
	XMLName           xml.Name `xml:"modify_agents"`
	Agents            []Agent  `xml:"agents>agent"`

	MinInterval       *int     `xml:"min_interval,omitempty"`

type Report struct {
	Value            string              `xml:",chardata"`
	ID               string              `xml:"id,attr"`
	FormatID         string              `xml:"format_id,attr"`

	InvisibleAlerts        *int                       `xml:"invisible_alerts,omitempty"`
	ReportConfigs          *ReportFormatReportConfigs `xml:"report_configs,omitempty"`
	InvisibleReportConfigs *int                       `xml:"invisible_report_configs,omitempty"`
	Signature              string                     `xml:"signature,omitempty"`
	File                   []ReportFormatFile         `xml:"file,omitempty"`
	Deprecated             *GMPBool                   `xml:"deprecated,omitempty"`
	Param                  []ReportFormatParam        `xml:"param,omitempty"`
	Comment                string                     `xml:"comment" gmpoverride:"T-9 report_format review: schema's report_format pattern never declares <comment>, but gvmd emits one on every report format — x5 in internal/gmptest/testdata/live/get_report_formats/001_response.xml, x6 in 006_response.xml (after a report format copy was added to the fixture set), and x1 upstream, all recorded as DROPPED in the matching _fidelity.txt. Every captured occurrence is empty, so it is the element's presence that is evidenced, not its content; hence no omitempty, which would re-marshal to the absence gvmd never sends"`
}

The full shape — optional element, chardata text plus optional type/method attributes — is the exact declaration get_nvts' OWN live schema snapshot (internal/codegen/testdata/schema/get_nvts.json's get_nvts_response/nvt/solution) already carries for the identical nvt/solution reuse, already proven correct as commands.NVTSolution (commands/get_nvts.go); no live get_results fixture happens to send a non-empty type, method or text, so those parts are evidenced by get_nvts' own schema declaration and generated type, not by get_results' own captures"`
	Refs       *ResultRefs      `xml:"refs,omitempty"`
	EPSS       *ResultEPSS      `xml:"epss,omitempty"`
}

type RoleCount struct {
	Value    int `xml:",chardata" gmpoverride:"T-23: command_get_roles.xml's role_count <pattern> declares only <e>filtered</e>/<e>page</e>, no chardata, but the command's own baked <example> shows a bare leading total (\"1<filtered>1</filtered><page>1</page>\") and every live fixture agrees — internal/gmptest/testdata/live/get_roles/001_response.xml sends <role_count>6<filtered>6</filtered><page>6</page></role_count>. A zero total is equally real: internal/gmptest/testdata/live/get_alerts/001_response.xml's matching <alert_count>0<filtered>0</filtered><page>0</page></alert_count> proves the leading text can be \"0\", which rules out modeling this with omitempty (an int chardata field with omitempty added to its xml tag drops the whole element on marshal, zero or not — confirmed by a standalone encoding/xml experiment — so this and every entry below omits OmitEmpty entirely)"`
	Filtered int `xml:"filtered"`
	Page     int `xml:"page"`
}

type Settings struct {
	Start   int               `xml:"start,attr"`
	Max     int               `xml:"max,attr"`
	Setting []SettingsSetting `xml:"setting,omitempty" gmpoverride:"T-9 settings review: command_get_settings.xml's <settings> pattern declares only the start/max pagination attributes, but the command's own <example> — reproduced verbatim in testdata/upstream/get_settings/001_response.xml — nests a real <setting id=\"...\"> inside <settings>, the same pattern-vs-example disagreement as verify_scanner's version; without this field the round trip silently drops that nested setting (confirmed by the upstream fixture's DROPPED settings/setting finding). No live capture against current gvmd ever produces this nested shape — every live fixture uses the flat top-level <setting> siblings already modelled by GetSettingsResponse.Setting — so this is an alternate/legacy wire form kept alongside the flat one, not a replacement for it"`
}

	Value   string `xml:"value"`
	ID      string `xml:"id,attr" gmpoverride:"T-9 settings review: command_get_settings.xml's formal <setting> pattern declares only name/comment/value, no id attribute, but internal/gmptest/testdata/live/get_settings/{001,002,003}_response.xml all show every <setting id=\"...\"> carrying a real UUID — the schema's own baked <example> agrees a setting has an id, it just nests <setting> inside <settings> in a way no live capture ever confirms"`
}

type SystemReportReport struct {
	Value     string   `xml:",chardata"`
	Format    string   `xml:"format,attr"`
	Duration  string   `xml:"duration,attr"`
	StartTime *GMPTime `xml:"start_time,attr,omitempty" gmpoverride:"T-9 system_report review: command_get_system_reports.xml's <report> pattern never declares start_time, but internal/gmptest/testdata/live/get_system_reports/001_response.xml sends a real start_time=\"0001-01-01T00:00:00Z\" attribute — undeclared but genuine wire data, confirmed dropped by that fixture's own pre-adoption fidelity report; testdata/upstream/get_system_reports/002_response.xml proves the attribute is also genuinely absent on other reports, so it is pointer-typed (unlike this codebase's usual non-pointer GMPTime convention) to actually honor omitempty on re-encode rather than fabricate a zero timestamp for a report that never had one"`
	EndTime   *GMPTime `xml:"end_time,attr,omitempty" gmpoverride:"T-9 system_report review: same undeclared-but-real, genuinely optional attribute as start_time above, same evidence and same pointer-typing rationale"`
}

type Vuln struct {
	ID               string      `xml:"id,attr"`
	Name             string      `xml:"name"`
	CreationTime     GMPTime     `xml:"creation_time"`
	ModificationTime GMPTime     `xml:"modification_time"`
	Severity         float64     `xml:"severity"`
	QOD              int         `xml:"qod"`
	Results          VulnResults `xml:"results"`
	Hosts            VulnHosts   `xml:"hosts"`
	Type             string      `xml:"type" gmpoverride:"T-9 vuln review: command_get_vulns.xml's vuln <pattern> list omits <e>type</e>, but the command still declares a full <ele><name>type</name></ele> body for it a few lines down (alts nvt/cve) — a dangling definition the pattern forgot to reference, not evidence the field doesn't exist; every fixture (live and upstream) sends a real <type>nvt</type>, the same pattern-omits-a-fully-defined-element class as verify_scanner's version"`
}

type Client interface {
	GetTasksRaw(ctx context.Context, cmd *commands.GetTasks) (*commands.GetTasksResponse, error)
	GetResultsRaw(ctx context.Context, cmd *commands.GetResults) (*commands.GetResultsResponse, error)
	GetAssetsRaw(ctx context.Context, cmd *commands.GetAssets) (*commands.GetAssetsResponse, error)
	GetTargetsRaw(ctx context.Context, cmd *commands.GetTargets) (*commands.GetTargetsResponse, error)
	GetTicketsRaw(ctx context.Context, cmd *commands.GetTickets) (*commands.GetTicketsResponse, error)
	GetPortListsRaw(ctx context.Context, cmd *commands.GetPortLists) (*commands.GetPortListsResponse, error)
	GetSettingsRaw(ctx context.Context, cmd *commands.GetSettings) (*commands.GetSettingsResponse, error)
}

func DefaultPaginationOptions() PaginationOptions

type Iterator[T any] struct {
	Client          Client
	Ctx             context.Context
	Opts            PaginationOptions
	Filters         []string
	current         []T
	index           int
	Page            int
	HasMoreData     bool
	total           int
	err             error
	closed          bool
	buildCommand    func(filter string) interface{}
	executeAndParse func(cmd interface{}, pageOpts PaginationOptions) (items []T, totalFiltered int, hasMore bool, err error)
}

func (it *Iterator[T]) Close()

func (it *Iterator[T]) Current() T

func (it *Iterator[T]) Err() error

func (it *Iterator[T]) HasMore() bool

func (it *Iterator[T]) Next() bool

func (it *Iterator[T]) Total() int

func NewAssetIterator(client Client, ctx context.Context, opts PaginationOptions, filters ...string) *AssetIterator

func NewPortListIterator(client Client, ctx context.Context, opts PaginationOptions, filters ...string) *PortListIterator

func NewResultIterator(client Client, ctx context.Context, opts PaginationOptions, filters ...string) *ResultIterator

func NewSettingsIterator(client Client, ctx context.Context, opts PaginationOptions, filters ...string) *SettingsIterator

func NewTargetIterator(client Client, ctx context.Context, opts PaginationOptions, filters ...string) *TargetIterator

func NewTaskIterator(client Client, ctx context.Context, opts PaginationOptions, filters ...string) *TaskIterator

func NewTicketIterator(client Client, ctx context.Context, opts PaginationOptions, filters ...string) *TicketIterator

type Pager[T any] interface {
	Next() bool
	Current() T
	Err() error
	HasMore() bool
	Total() int
	Close()
}

type PaginationOptions struct {
	Page     int
	PageSize int
	MaxItems int
}
